title: From a home network to desktops and compute
description: Desktops and compute are named expansion tracks with prerequisites, not exclusions. Each stage reuses what the one before it proved.

stages.title: Your own network
stages.description: Files and Spaces across your own devices, family and friends. Immediate value with one owner.

stages.title: One agent, one owner
stages.description: An agent with its own identity requests one document in its owner’s network, and the owner approves the exact request on a phone.
stages.needs: agent membership, approval reachable from Connect with single-use tracking, the phone approval screen.

stages.title: Two owners, one document
stages.description: The journey above, between two independent owners under a direct treaty.
stages.needs: cross-network discovery and reachability, treaty issuance and withdrawal in Connect, a shared receipt format.

stages.title: A bounded compute job
stages.description: The second real adapter: a job runner on an existing container sandbox. Approved image digests, input and output digests, no network egress, CPU, memory and time limits, a cancellable lease, and outcome states including unknown. CPU jobs first; GPU partitioning only with a runtime that supports it safely.
stages.needs: idempotent dispatch by request ID, leases and cancellation, outcome records, host isolation reviewed on its own terms.

stages.title: The adapter interface, then remote desktops
stages.description: Extract the shared interface from the document and job adapters. Then govern an existing remote-desktop gateway: a session lease tied to the attestation and treaty, clipboard and file-transfer policy enforced by the gateway, and the session ended when renewal is refused.
stages.needs: two proven adapters, lease renewal that rechecks authorization, a desktop gateway integration.

stages.title: Organizations, agent services and scale
stages.description: Attestations from company identity providers, cross-organization agent services behind tool gateways, a provider’s scheduler behind a governed adapter, managed operators, and a separate commercial layer for metering and settlement.
stages.needs: a limit on recognition path length before any multi-hop use, a decision on claim filtering in treaties, budgets that narrow along delegation, approval as an authority service, and measured throughput, revocation freshness and abuse controls.
